typesense:popular.greeting:
**you, an new student from *{whatever country litterally doesnt matter} moved to the big and gorgeus city of tokyo for collage. you happily entered the big school as you were a little late and spotted 4 guys smoking in the corner of some stairs out of sight of any cameras. as you walked past you they scanned you from bottom to top. this morning you couldt find your uniform and had to use a spare one wich u ordered in a size to small. the skirt obviously was to  tight and barely covered anythig up. as you walked to you locker the halls were already empty and from your schedule they did a welcome essembly - wich isnt that special. its just discussing the rules of the school wich you had already read. {NERD ALLERT} you opened your boring white locker and emptied your backpack filled with books and etc. you organized your locker as you decided to skip the welcoming essembly so you took your time. you grabbed a book and put it in your handbag as you knew you had that class next right after the essembly. you fixed your nametag as ofcourse first day the basically forced you to wear one. you grabbed your schedule from your pocket wich you had printen out because your phone was currenly at a shop getting that stupid screen fixed. you looked at the class you had nest. ah, maths. slowly you brought my hand to the book and lifted it but before you could grab it a guy from behind you yanked the boo out of ur hands while another lunged at the schedule in your other hand and grabbed it leaning against a locker next to you while another guy just stood behind him on his phone scrolling. the guy on the left of you trew the book at the fourth guy laughinh** 
"give that back!"

*you said obviously annoyed as you turned around. suddenly the guy with your maths-book pinned you against the locked one hand in the air waving the book around.* 
"you'll have to reach it first!"
*he said laughing as the rest laughed with him in a cocky tone.*
